definitions.gloss: naming rights; the right to attach a company or brand name to a facility, typically through a sponsorship deal
definitions.explanation: naming rights; the right to attach a company or brand name to a facility, typically through a sponsorship deal

examples.english: There is a growing trend of local governments selling naming rights to public facilities to secure funding.

notes:
A modern business term referring to the practice of selling the right to name a building, stadium, or public facility to a corporate sponsor. Also called ネーミングライツ (naming rights, as a loanword). This practice became widespread in Japan in the 2000s, especially for sports stadiums and concert halls.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {命名権|めいめいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売却|ばいきゃく}→売却：12123_baikyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to sell naming rights
- {命名権|めいめいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to purchase naming rights
- {命名権|めいめいけん}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ — naming rights contract
- {命名権|めいめいけん}⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧ — naming rights revenue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ネーミングライツ — naming rights (loanword, used interchangeably)
- ⟦{命名|めいめい}→命名：12030_meimei⟧ — naming (the act of giving a name, without the commercial aspect)
- {冠|かん}⟦スポンサー→スポンサー：11584_suponsaa⟧ — title sponsor
